goal: Bring Home "Hôm nay" in line with the approved design canvas (Main artboard): Today card hero with a card fan and the streak inside it, time-aware subtitle, sign tile with the sign artwork, a topic rail with Change topic, a single Continue reading card, pill-shaped buttons/inputs/chips, and a bottom bar labelled Hôm nay and Tôi.
successCriteria: Home shows, in order: header with bell, date and moon kicker, greeting, time-aware subtitle, Today card hero (solid surface, gold border, two stacked card backs, primary button, streak dots inside the hero), sky tile and sign tile with the sign artwork, Hỏi Nilaza field and chips, Dành cho bạn rail with Đổi chủ đề, and Đọc tiếp with the latest saved entry.

The Dành cho bạn rail has three cards per topic (love, career, self): a topic tarot reading, an ask card that only prefills Oracle (Owner decision 2026-10-30 replaces the compatibility card), and a journal prompt that opens the Journal composer with that prompt; Đổi chủ đề cycles the three topics without saving anything.

Đọc tiếp shows the newest Journal entry with up to three card thumbnails for saved tarot readings and a meta line (kind, relative day, saved); the existing AI Council continuation card still appears when a council session exists.
Primary, secondary, ritual buttons and chips in the shared components, and the Home controls, use a pill radius; cards and panels keep the 8px radius (Owner decision 2026-10-30).
The bottom bar reads Hôm nay, Khám phá, Trò chuyện, Nhật ký, Tôi (English: Today, Explore, Chat, Journal, Me) with sun and chat-bubble icons and a gold-tinted selected item.
npm --workspace apps/mobile run check and the mobile Jest suite pass, and a 390x844 web walkthrough confirms each Home block and the journal prompt.
untouchedSurfaces: Tarot card data in packages/content stays unchanged in this slice; Vietnamese card names are only drafted in docs/content-review for Owner review before they enter the data.
No compatibility feature, no new spread, no per-topic card meanings; those are separate Owner-approved content tasks.
Today Pulse, daily limits, journal storage shape, AI endpoints, backend, Admin and release settings are unchanged.
Other screens keep their bespoke styles until their own slices; only shared buttons and chips change shape app-wide.

impact.canonicalContract: DESIGN.md section 5 Home paragraph and docs/BRAND_GUIDELINES.md describe the new Home order and the pill-control rule; theme radius gains a pill token while card stays 8.
impact.privacySafety: No new data collected; the compatibility card that would need a third person's birth date is not built.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; no data migration.
impact.surfacesIntentionallyUntouched: Card names data, spreads, per-topic meanings, Astrology, Chat, Journal list and Profile layouts are left for later slices.
impact.agentHandoff: The delivery agent owns only the writeScope, runs type check, Jest and a web walkthrough, and stops before commit, push, backend, release or account actions unless the Owner asks.

DESIGN.md section 5 Home structure (Owner-approved 2026-10-27) is updated by this task to match the design canvas.

managerTestPath: Open Hôm nay: the card hero shows two stacked card backs and the streak inside it; tap Đổi chủ đề to switch Tình yêu, Công việc, Bản thân; tap Viết về một mối quan hệ to open a note with that prompt; tap the Đọc tiếp card to open the last saved entry; the bottom bar shows Hôm nay and Tôi.
